mapper.sql: id, event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, topic, payload, status, retry_count, last_error, created_at, processed_at, next_retry_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox (event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, topic, payload, status, retry_count, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{topic}, #{payload}, 'PENDING', 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE outbox SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, status = 'PENDING' WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox WHERE status = #{status}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM outbox WHERE status = 'PROCESSED' AND processed_at <= #{cutoff}
